title: Data-efficiency curves
caption: Frozen-test top-1 against the nested per-class training fraction. Line is the mean over 3 seeds, band is +/-1 SD. Solid = full fine-tuning, dashed = linear probe on frozen features.

title: Corruption degradation curves
caption: Top-1 against corruption severity for each family, at 100% training data. Mean over 3 seeds, band +/-1 SD. Corruptions are applied deterministically on the fly, identically for both architectures.

title: Frequency-response curves
caption: Accuracy when only frequencies below (left) or above (right) the cutoff radius survive an ideal filter. Dotted line marks Nyquist along an axis. f100, full fine-tuning, mean over 3 seeds.

title: Band-limited noise sensitivity
caption: Top-1 under additive noise confined to one frequency annulus and rescaled to a constant spatial RMS, so band position is the only variable. Lower means more vulnerable at that frequency.

title: Calibration
caption: Left: reliability diagram at f100 -- points below the diagonal are over-confident. Right: expected calibration error against training fraction, mean over seeds.

title: Error overlap
caption: Left: how the test set splits by which model was right. Right: kappa corrects agreement for chance; 'same wrong label' isolates shared inductive bias from merely shared difficulty.

title: Deployment cost
caption: Static cost (parameters, GMACs at 224) and cost measured on the real workload (peak training VRAM, training throughput on an RTX 4060 8 GB).
